convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iStochastic indicator. Simple crossover entry/exit rules. Fixed lot sizing with digit adjustment. No external libraries or custom indicators. Straightforward signal logic on completed bars.

other_exits: Close opposite position on reversal signal before entering new trade

custom_logic_notes: The EA implements a custom OHLC Stochastic calculation rather than using the built-in iStochastic handle. It manually computes %K and %D from OHLC data with the stochastic formula applied to bar open/high/low/close values. The crossover logic uses previous completed bar values (shift 1 and 2) to avoid repainting. When a reversal signal occurs, the existing opposite position is closed before a new position is opened.
python_conversion_notes: The custom OHLC Stochastic computation needs to be reimplemented manually in Python since it does not use the standard iStochastic handle. The %K/%D crossover logic is straightforward: compare main and signal line values at bar[-1] and bar[-2] to detect crossover. Digit adjustment logic (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. The new-bar detection pattern using static datetime must be converted to a bar-based check. Position check before entry is simple: verify no open positions exist before placing a trade, and close opposite positions on signal reversal.
